title: hello
description: any → server. First message on every connection. Declares the protocol version and the kind of application. The server answers hello.ok, or error VERSION_MISMATCH followed by bye and close.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version the sender implements. This document defines version 1.

client.description: Kind of application. Selects the frame-size and rate budget of the connection.

appVersion.description: Build version of the application, for logs only.

lang.description: Preferred language of the device, used only for server-chosen nickname suggestions. Default "en".

ClientKind.description: Kind of application opening the connection.

LangTag.description: BCP 47 language tag, lower-case primary subtag (e.g. "en", "ar", "pt-BR").
